title: Hayati Pro Max Mad Blue Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Hayati Pro Max Mad Blue is a bold and juicy blend of dark berries, fusing Blackberry, Blackcurrant and Raspberry for a deeply fruity vape. The richness of Blackberry and Blackcurrant brings a tangy, slightly earthy base, while Raspberry cuts through with a lighter, tart finish—creating a deftly layered flavour that’s intense but well balanced. Blended with nicotine salts for rapid absorption and a smoother throat hit, this e-liquid is designed for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping using low-powered pod kits and starter devices. The 50VG/50PG formula delivers dependable flavour and discreet vapour with every puff. This flavour is part of the Hayati Pro Max Nic Salt range, inspired by Hayati’s own bestselling disposable vapes and now reimagined in a longer-lasting 10ml format—available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths.
